sources.label: Wikipedia, "LTT 9779 b"
sources.quote: LTT 9779 b, officially named Cuancoá, is a Neptune-sized planet orbiting the sunlike star LTT 9779, or Uúba.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around LTT 9779. Its orbit and size follow Jenkins et al. 2020's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "LTT 9779 b"
sources.quote: As of 2023, it has the highest-known albedo of any planet.
